decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The capping stone shall be a Portland rather than Bathstone colour.

Condition : 3 - 2.	Where older bricks are to be re-used, or where bonding into the old wall, the mortar mix should not contain cement (for joint or point). An appropriate well-graded aggregate (ie at least 3, preferably 4 particle sizes), with lime putty (preferably) or natural hydraulic lime to a maximum strength of 3.5, shall be used, the joint finish flush and tamped to expose the aggregate.
Condition : 4 - The width and head detail shall match existing.
Condition : 5 - The projecting bands of brick in the piers shall stagger no more than 15-20mm.
description: Following approval for demolition of existing gateway columns & part of wall, widening of gateway and erection of new columns and wall to create visibilty splay to crossover - details submitted pursuant to Condition 2 (materials) of approved planning permission ref 00647/348/P9 dated 03/08/2004.
